title: [RPG Design Guides] Difficulty ① What Kind of Difficulty Should You Aim For?

blocks.source: 【RPG制作講座】難易度① どんな難易度を目指すのか？
blocks.translation: [RPG Design Guides] Difficulty ① What Kind of Difficulty Should You Aim For?

blocks.source: エンカウント率に関しては、低めでいいと明確な結論を出してみた。しかし、ゲーム全体の難易度が「難しければいいか」「易しければいいか」という問題に関して明確な答えを出すことは難しい。
blocks.translation: I came to the clear conclusion that a relatively low encounter rate is fine. However, it is difficult to give a clear answer to whether the overall difficulty of a game should be “difficult” or “easy.”

blocks.source: 全てのプレイヤーが納得する難易度というものは存在しない
blocks.translation: There is no difficulty level that satisfies every player

blocks.source: ため、対象とするプレイヤーの層や作品の方向性に合わせて考える必要がある。
blocks.translation: so you need to consider the target audience and the direction of the game.

blocks.source: プレイヤーの種類で、難易度を分類すると以下のようなものが挙げられる。
blocks.translation: Classifying difficulty by player type gives us the following categories.

blocks.source: DQ、FFの様な、シナリオ・システムを両立させた万人向け難易度。
blocks.translation: A difficulty level for everyone, like DQ and FF, balancing the scenario and system.

blocks.source: クロノトリガー等、シナリオ重視の簡単でテンポの良い難易度。
blocks.translation: An easy, fast-paced difficulty focused on the scenario, like Chrono Trigger.

blocks.source: ロマサガシリーズのような、戦闘重視の難易度。ややヘビーユーザ向け。
blocks.translation: A battle-focused difficulty like the Romancing SaGa series. Intended for somewhat more hardcore users.

blocks.source: DQ2、女神転生シリーズのような、全滅前提の難易度。さらにヘビーユーザ向け。
blocks.translation: A difficulty designed around the assumption that you will be wiped out, like DQ2 and the Megami Tensei series. Intended for even more hardcore users.

blocks.source: 下２つの例は「ヘビーユーザ向け」で一括りにされることもあるけれど、個人的には別物と考えたほうがよいように思う。というのも、僕はサガシリーズの難易度は大好きでもＤＱ２やメガテンは苦手だったりする。
blocks.translation: The latter two examples are sometimes grouped together as being “for hardcore users,” but personally, I think it is better to consider them separate. The reason is that although I love the difficulty of the SaGa series, I am not good at DQ2 or Megaten.

blocks.source: サガシリーズ（特にロマサガ２以降）はきちんと戦略を練れば、安定して戦闘で勝利できるように調整されている。万が一、運が悪くとも『どこでもセーブ』によって、すぐにやり直せるようになっている。
blocks.translation: The SaGa series (especially from Romancing SaGa 2 onward) is balanced so that you can win battles consistently if you plan your strategy properly. Even if you happen to have bad luck, the ability to save anywhere lets you try again right away.

blocks.source: 対して、女神転生（特に真女神転生３など）やＤＱ２は運が悪ければ、プレイヤースキルに関係なく戦闘で全滅する理不尽な箇所がある。全滅自体を楽しむ余裕がないときつい。
blocks.translation: By contrast, Megami Tensei (especially Shin Megami Tensei III) and DQ2 contain unreasonable sections where bad luck can wipe out your party in battle regardless of your player skill. They are tough unless you can afford to enjoy being wiped out itself.

blocks.source: 上記の大雑把な分け方だけで４タイプもあるため、「難易度の調整って何だか難しい」と思ってしまう方もいるかもしれない。けれど、その点はさほど気にしなくてもいい。実は難易度はエンカウント率など快適性に関わる項目と比較すると問題になりにくい。多少難しすぎたり、易しすぎたりしても、よっぽど極端でなければ酷評を受けることは少ない。
blocks.translation: The rough classification above alone gives us four types, so some people may think, “Adjusting the difficulty seems kind of difficult.” However, you do not need to worry too much about that. In fact, difficulty is less likely to become a problem than factors related to comfort, such as the encounter rate. Even if a game is somewhat too difficult or too easy, it is unlikely to receive harsh criticism unless it is extremely so.

blocks.source: 難しい：手応えがある。クリアした時の達成感がある。
blocks.translation: Difficult: It offers a real challenge. Clearing it gives you a sense of accomplishment.

blocks.source: 簡単：サクサク進む。雰囲気やストーリーを楽しめる。
blocks.translation: Easy: You can progress smoothly. You can enjoy the atmosphere and story.

blocks.source: というようにプレイヤーはある程度までは、いいように解釈してくれたりする。作品の方向性に合わせて、
blocks.translation: As this shows, players will interpret things favorably to some extent. In line with the direction of the game,

blocks.source: 「シナリオ重視ならば易しく」
blocks.translation: "If the scenario is the focus, make it easy"

blocks.source: 「システム重視ならば難しく（ただし、クリアできる程度に）」
blocks.translation: "If the system is the focus, make it difficult (as long as it remains beatable)"

blocks.source: となるように、意識して調整しておけば、多少失敗しても大きな問題はないはず。
blocks.translation: if you consciously adjust the difficulty accordingly, then even some mistakes should not cause any major problems.

blocks.source: なお「シナリオ重視ならば易しく」というのは、そのほうがテンポ良くシナリオを楽しめるから。
blocks.translation: The reason for “if the scenario is the focus, make it easy” is that this makes it possible to enjoy the scenario at a better pace.

blocks.source: 根本的にエンカウント率が高かったり、操作性が悪かったりしては難易度を易しくしたところで元も子もないのでご注意。
blocks.translation: Keep in mind that if the encounter rate is fundamentally too high or the controls are poor, making the difficulty easier will not solve the underlying problem.

blocks.source: 特に大きなこだわりがなければ、大半のプレイヤーが攻略情報を全く見ずにクリアできることを、目指すとよいかも。特にストーリー性や冒険性を重視したＲＰＧなら、最後まで見て欲しいと思うのも作者心というもの。その上で、タイプ１～３までのプレイヤーを同時に取り込むことは十分可能なはず。
blocks.translation: Unless you have particularly strong preferences, it may be a good idea to aim for a game that most players can clear without looking at a walkthrough at all. Especially for an RPG that emphasizes its story or sense of adventure, wanting players to see it through to the end is simply part of an author's nature. Even so, it should be entirely possible to appeal to players of types 1 through 3 at the same time.

blocks.source: 例えば、サガシリーズでは敵を強くする代わりに、どこでもセーブなどの救済要素・快適要素を加えることで、戦闘で全滅するリスクを減らしている。また、成長システムが多彩でおもしろいため、戦闘に負けても、キャラクターを鍛えて再挑戦すればいいという気持ちが湧いてくる。このようにすれば、ある程度のライトユーザにもくじけず最後までプレイする気力を与えることは可能となる。
blocks.translation: For example, in the SaGa series, the risk of being wiped out in battle is reduced by adding helpful and convenience features such as saving anywhere, while making the enemies stronger. Also, because the growth systems are varied and interesting, even after losing a battle, you feel motivated to train your characters and try again. In this way, it is possible to give even relatively light users the motivation to keep playing to the end without giving up.

blocks.source: この例はタイプ３の作品が１，２向けのプレイヤーを取り込んでいる例となる。逆に、タイプ１，２の作品がタイプ３，４のプレイヤーを取り込むには、難易度設定や裏ボスなどの要素を使う方法が挙げられる。
blocks.translation: This is an example of a type 3 game appealing to players of types 1 and 2. Conversely, type 1 and 2 games can appeal to type 3 and 4 players by using features such as difficulty settings and superbosses.

blocks.source: 実のところ極端なヘビーユーザを除けば、万人向けの難易度を実現するのはそう難しくないような気もする。ＲＰＧとはアクション性などは基本的に要求されない分野なので、ライトユーザ側には経験値稼ぎなどの成長システムで、比較的簡単に配慮できるというのが理由。
blocks.translation: In fact, excluding extremely hardcore users, I feel that achieving a difficulty level for everyone may not be all that difficult. RPGs are fundamentally a genre that does not require action skills and the like, so light users can be accommodated relatively easily through growth systems such as experience grinding.

blocks.source: というわけで、ＤＱ２やメガテン、あるいは一部のファイアーエムブレム並の難易度がないと、楽しめない生粋のヘビーユーザはひとまず置いておく。当講座ではライトユーザから、ややヘビーユーザまでを広く対象とした（上記の１～３に当たる。）万人向けのＲＰＧを作るための難易度を考える。
blocks.translation: With that in mind, I will set aside the die-hard hardcore users who cannot enjoy a game unless it has difficulty on the level of DQ2, Megaten, or some Fire Emblem games. In these guides, I will consider the difficulty needed to create an RPG for everyone, broadly targeting light users through somewhat hardcore users (corresponding to types 1 through 3 above).

blocks.source: そもそも、４のタイプのゲームは僕自身が余り受け付けないので、どう調整していいのか良く分からんのです。マゾいのは苦手です。ご理解ください。
blocks.translation: To begin with, I myself cannot really handle type 4 games, so I have no idea how to adjust them. I am not good with masochistic difficulty. Please understand.
